string.text: Parks classic BHS pieces and related bars off-screen (keeps them alive to avoid spawn animations). Each piece has its own hide rules. Status icons use separate gates. Turn Medik Status icons ON if Medik is installed. Align Medik psy hide with the psy toggle below.
Park the BHS silhouette and limb health fills together. Shown on damage flash or while the hold key is down.
Unpark body/limb health, actor health bar, and psy bar while held. No key bound by default.
Unpark body/limb health, actor health, and psy after limb damage. Duration below; 0 disables even if this is on.
How long body/limb health stays unparked after limb damage. Further hits refresh the timer. 0 = off.
If all limbs heal to full during a damage flash, remaining show time is clamped to this value. 0 = hide immediately when full.
Park the BHS actor health bar unless health is below the threshold.
Unpark the health bar while actor health is under this percent.
Park the BHS stamina bar unless stamina is below the threshold.
Unpark the stamina bar while power is under this percent.
Park the maingame psy bar unless psy is below the threshold. Leave Medik psy hide aligned with this.
Unpark the psy bar while psy health is under this percent.
Park the SidHUD radiation-over-health bar unless radiation is above the threshold.
Unpark the SidHUD rad bar while radiation percent is above this value. 0 = show whenever you have any rads.
Manage the status icon strip: hide by default, then show only opted-in icons below (and while the status hold key is down).
Show opted-in status icons while held, including grey. No key bound by default.
Allow the radiation status icon when yellow or worse. Grey uses the grace slider at the bottom.
Allow the bleed status icon (Actor Damage Balancer) when yellow or worse.
Allow the hunger status icon when yellow or worse.
Allow the thirst status icon when yellow or worse.
Allow the sleep status icon when yellow or worse.
Seconds to keep a grey (mild) opted-in icon visible after it becomes grey, then hide it. 0 = never show grey. Yellow+ clears the timer.
